summary: Add monitors under spec.resources of a device, for example a Disk monitor on /application_data sampling every 5s with a Warning at 75% over 30m and Critical at 90% over 10m.
questions: How do I configure a disk usage alert for an edge device?
Where do resource monitors go in the device spec?
Example Edge Manager disk monitor YAML

answer_card.title: Disk monitor on a device
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
spec:
  resources:
  - monitorType: Disk
    samplingInterval: 5s
    path: /application_data
    alertRules:
    - severity: Warning
      duration: 30m
      percentage: 75
      description: Disk space for application data is >75% full for over 30m.
    - severity: Critical
      duration: 10m
      percentage: 90
      description: Disk space for application data is >90% full over 10m.
```
Monitor types: `CPU`, `Memory`, `Disk`; one rule per severity.
